Proxima Centauri is 4.24 light-years away. Voyager, moving at more than 3 AU a year, would need about 89,000 years. Breakthrough Starshot's probes are designed for about 15% of light speed: about 28 years. For the crew, the clock on board runs slower: at nearly the speed of light (a Lorentz factor of about 223,000), a 4.24 light-year trip takes about 10 minutes of ship time.

review.notes: Semantic review after adding a bar-comparison scene: the bars reuse facts already in this episode's record. Times are the same as the cards (twin paradox 40 and 52,000 years round trip; Proxima 89,000 and 28 years; light 8 min 20 s and 43 min). The 'thousands of times longer' line is 89,000 divided by 28, about 3,200. The 'about five times longer' line is 43 divided by 8.3, about 5.2. The log-scale bars are labelled as log scale on screen; the light bars are drawn to scale. No new claims.
